# Step - drop_compression

`drop_compression` · category: [Compressed properties](../../traversal/step_reference.md#compressed-properties)

Removes a compression rule and decompresses its values; false when there is none.

## Forms

```text
drop_compression(arg1: string)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
{ g.define_compression(#{name: "bio", label: "person", path: "bio"}); g.drop_compression("bio") }   // true
```
